name: error-filter-kind-mismatch-indexed
$comment: SEC-126 typing on the indexed path: a filter comparison leaf against an INDEXED field types its value through the same eq_bind_for conversion as index eq binds — a JSON number (42) against a declared string field is rejected with BAD_REQUEST ('eq value must be a string') before execution, not evaluated permissively. Mirrors server query/filter.rs field_lhs_and_bind → eq_bind_for (dsl.rs). Engines that lazily coerce or no-match instead of rejecting diverge from the server.
